bounds: One dispatched organization checkout, one provider session, clock 0..12 in ticks of the first read-back age, backoff cap 4, provider retry horizon 10 and a one-tick create-settle margin. The production values are 2 minutes, 30 minutes, 23 hours and 5 minutes.
fairness: A captured payment settles under weak fairness of the clock and of both sweep lanes. Without the sweep the property has a counterexample, which is checked.
limitations: One dispatched organization checkout, one provider session, clock 0..12 in ticks of the first read-back age, backoff cap 4, provider retry horizon 10 and a one-tick create-settle margin. The production values are 2 minutes, 30 minutes, 23 hours and 5 minutes.

Each sweep step is one atomic observation and settlement. Command compare-and-swap, revision history and entitlement publication are refined by PlatformSubscriptionCommand and SubscriptionTerminalReceipt. Composition is not mechanically established.
Lane budgets, ordering among several checkouts and the one provider account read per sweep are outside this single-checkout instance. The repository tests cover them.

The provider is trusted to report open, complete, expired or missing truthfully for the command's own customer and session. A session that expires on its own before the horizon is observed, never forced.
An unavailable provider read rotates the checkout like an open one and is counted as a read-back. A prepared command that never dispatched is outside the read-back lane and this instance.
Settlement without the webhook is conditional on the sweep running. Cron scheduling and provider availability are not promised.

sourceMapping.Due/ReadBack: listDispatchedCheckoutsDueForInspection and the inspection lane of recoverStaleSubscriptionCheckouts; rotateCheckoutRecovery stamps inspectedAt
sourceMapping.Stale/Close: listStalePendingCheckouts and the closure lane; expireOpen only for a fenced organization
sourceMapping.Applied: reconcileSubscriptionCheckout from settlePendingCheckout, the webhook and checkout/confirm
sourceMapping.Materialize: the original idempotent session create inside PROVIDER_RETRY_WINDOW_MS; noSessionDisposition

assumptions: Checked formula in SubscriptionCheckoutReadBack: PaidSettlesWithoutWebhook = Fairness implies always(s.session == "complete" implies eventually(s.command == "applied"))
Model fairness predicate Fairness = Tick.weakFair(s) and ReadBack.weakFair(s) and Close.weakFair(s)
The property is conditional on its written model fairness. Real cron scheduling, provider availability and implementation refinement are not proved.
No fairness is assumed. With a lost webhook and no sweep, confirm or clock progress a paid checkout can stay pending forever; this negative check prevents an unconditional settlement claim.
